description: This Java source file defines the class SimpleCommandResponse, which models an immutable, JSON-serializable response for commands within an Akka-based service in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON strings or objects, accessing optional fields, and converting instances back to JSON.

classes.name: SimpleCommandResponse
classes.description: An immutable, JSON-serializable class representing a command response, optionally containing a correlation ID and payload.

classes.name: SimpleCommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested static class defining the JSON field names used in serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: SimpleCommandResponse.of
methods.description: Creates a new SimpleCommandResponse instance with the given correlation ID and payload.

methods.name: SimpleCommandResponse.fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create a SimpleCommandResponse instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: SimpleCommandResponse.getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the correlation ID, if present.

methods.name: SimpleCommandResponse.getPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload JsonValue, if present.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the SimpleCommandResponse instance into a JsonObject for serialization.
